title: Sound
summary: Plays audio: set SoundId, call Play(). Parented to a part = 3D positional audio (fades with distance); played via SoundService:PlayLocalSound = client-only UI audio. Supports loops, playback speed, and the Ended event.

properties.name: TimePosition / Length
properties.description: Current position in seconds / total length (after load).

properties.name: PlayOnRemove
properties.description: Plays once when the Sound is destroyed/removed — fire-and-forget one-shots.

methods.name: Play / Stop / Pause / Resume
methods.description: Playback control. Play with fade: Play() then tween Volume.

methods.name: PlayAsync
methods.description: Yields until the sound starts playing (loaded).

events.name: Ended
events.description: Fires when playback finishes (also per loop iteration for looped sounds).

events.name: MarkerReached
events.description: Fires when audio markers (set in the audio editor) are passed.

explanation.whatItIs: The audio player object. Point it at an asset, press play, tune how it behaves in space.
explanation.whyItExists: Games need footsteps, music, explosions — everywhere from whispers to world-wide tracks.
whenToUse: World sounds: parent to a part (3D positional)
Music: parent to SoundService or use one non-positional Sound
One-shots: PlayOnRemove pattern for fire-and-forget effects
UI sounds: SoundService:PlayLocalSound on the client
whenNotToUse: Creating a new Sound instance every play — reuse one instance and re-Play
Expecting client-created sounds to be heard by others (they aren't by default)
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Sound parented to Part → heard in 3D, fades with distance
Sound via PlayLocalSound → only this client hears it
Music: Looped=true, parented high (SoundService)

Play() → IsPlaying → Ended fires
```
tips: Wait for IsLoaded (or use PlayAsync) before reading Length
SoundGroups give you master volume sliders (music/sfx channels)
commonMistakes: Playing a sound before it's loaded → silent first play; use IsLoaded/PlayAsync
Spawning N Sound objects per shot — memory churn; reuse and re-Play
Changing SoundId without stopping — stop first for clean switches

examples.title: Positional explosion sound
examples.code:
local function explosionSound(position)
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.Transparency = 1
    part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    part.Position = position

    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://266022905"
    sound.Volume = 2
    sound.PlayOnRemove = true
    sound.Parent = part
    part.Parent = workspace

    game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(part, 0.1)
    -- Parenting + PlayOnRemove + immediate removal = clean one-shot
end

examples.title: Looped music with fade-in
examples.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local music = Instance.new("Sound")
music.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1837849285"
music.Looped = true
music.Volume = 0
music.Parent = SoundService
music:Play()

TweenService:Create(music, TweenInfo.new(3), { Volume = 0.6 }):Play()
